acceptance.description: A fresh packet collected from the live default NAS scope validates cleanly (shape/references).
This draft's refs re-link against the fresh packet with no dangling source/observation IDs.

check.review: Operator confirms the joined intended→deployed→available rows actually answer whether the evidence can be joined, or records why not.

acceptance.description: Operator judges whether the rendered join reads as a genuine intended/deployed/available comparison.

reads: research-state packet JSON/Markdown retained under the operator's XDG research-state dir
selected Thesis/Architecture note passages already cited in the packet

baseline_plan: Capture the fresh packet ID, its checkout_vs_pin comparison status, the deployed system-generation target, and the hermes-agent availability observation BEFORE any joining, so the later read can be compared against the same acceptance conditions.

computer_evidence.description: Example snapshot: CA checkout HEAD equals the flake.lock cognitive-assistant rev (agree). Replay of the 2026-10-01 agreeing snapshot pattern, NOT a live claim.
Example snapshot: locked flake input rev matching the checkout (agree). Same replay caveat as above.
Example snapshot: user Home Manager generation candidates absent at the checked paths, recorded as unknown deployment observations rather than proof HM is absent.

cost_limits.cost: no spend; read-only joins of already-retained packets

counterexample: A GOOD counterexample: the join renders cleanly (every row has intended, deployed, and available evidence) yet the operator finds it answers nothing they would act on — availability joined without usefulness. That kills the 'joinable therefore worthwhile' reading and keeps the result honest.

direction_refs.description: System loop: capture context, retrieve or research what is missing, execute, evaluate outcomes, reconcile successful patterns, feed improved knowledge back (Thesis line 32).
Design bias: start with narrow, measurable, local-first capabilities, expand autonomy only where proven (Thesis line 34).
Architectural requirements: modular, telemetry-rich, sandboxed, reversible by default; feedback loops and rollback are core (Thesis line 36).
Automation boundary: automate only where the goal is clear, the environment observable, success verifiable; otherwise surface evidence for human judgment (Thesis line 38).

falsifying_evidence: A fresh packet whose checkout_vs_pin comparison is unknown (missing CA checkout or lock), or whose Thesis excerpts fail to re-read, falsifies the premise that this join is currently performable — the result becomes insufficient_evidence, not a weaker join.

human_gate.reason: Draft example: needs a fresh live packet, ref re-link, and operator review of the meaning boundary before any contact beyond reading.

hypothesis: Recorded before results: the intended (Thesis direction), deployed (system generation), and available (service/outcome) evidence rows in a fresh packet can be joined into one readable comparison that shows whether the join itself is possible — without claiming any drift exists.
intended_capability: Join intended→deployed→available evidence rows from a single research-state packet into one readable comparison.
mechanism: Read-only: render the fresh packet to Markdown, align its checkout_vs_pin comparison, deployment observations, and named-service availability observations side by side, and record which cells are unknown vs evidenced. No commands run against live services; no configuration changes.

prerequisites.description: Fresh packet collected from the live default NAS scope (replaces this example snapshot).
CA checkout HEAD and flake.lock cognitive-assistant rev both present so checkout_vs_pin yields agree/different rather than unknown.
Whether the intended direction rows correspond to anything actually deployed: user generation paths were unknown in the snapshot, so deployed correspondence is still unknown.

protected_behavior: Nix-first declarative layer: every trace carries human intent; no automatic mutation; sandbox plus explicit approval. The join must not propose, stage, or perform any configuration change.
reversal: Nothing to reverse: the experiment only reads retained packets. Discard the rendered join if the operator judges it unhelpful; the packet itself is immutable history.
uncertainty: It is genuinely uncertain whether the three evidence layers share enough common keys (working object, revisions, generation targets) to join at all, and whether a successful join would be useful rather than merely available. This discovery resolves that uncertainty; it claims no existing drift and no supported capability.
